subject: Meta
notes: Operating-footprint oriented catalog for Meta (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp) full-grid legal research. Includes EU supranational + member countries, other UN members with practical consumer Meta availability, US states with comprehensive privacy and/or youth-safety/AADC/social-minor laws, and a minimal US city set. Excludes known total/near-total consumer blocks (e.g. PRC, DPRK, Iran). Some restricted markets (Russia, Belarus) remain for legal-status research with cautious rationales. Ids are stable slugs aligned with meta_legal.slugify; georgia_us disambiguates the U.S. state from the country Georgia. Not legal advice; provenance is desk research for scaffolding full-grid runs.
